sn51.77-86:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbā.
sn51.77-86:1.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.77-86:1.11: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime cattāro iddhipādā bhāvetabbāti.
